title: Three hearts, blue blood, thinking arms
summary: Octopuses have three hearts, copper-based blue blood and around 500 million neurons — about two-thirds of them in their arms, whose suckers can taste by touch.

scenes.text: Three hearts. Blue blood. Arms that partly think for themselves.
Octopuses are mollusks — relatives of snails and clams — yet among the most intelligent invertebrates known.
